title: Crypto accounting platform Cryptio warns customers that exchange and custodian credentials could be compromised
date_note: Cryptopolitan says Cryptio warned customers on 22 November; the company's own alert was not read.
geo_basis: The page names no location for Cryptio; placeholder point, not a real place
summary: Cryptopolitan reports that Cryptio, a crypto accounting platform, warned customers on 22 November that login credentials for partner exchanges and custodians could be compromised, and that the attacker used AI tools. A company representative told the outlet on 26 November that the unauthorized party attempted to move digital assets with some of those credentials, that all identified attempts failed and that no losses had been identified. The investigation is ongoing.
plain: Cryptopolitan reports Cryptio warned that credentials linking customers' exchange and custodian accounts could be compromised. A company representative says attempts to move assets failed and no losses have been identified.
exec: Cryptopolitan reports credentials Cryptio held for customers' exchange and custodian accounts could be compromised; the company says attempts to move assets failed and no losses have been identified.
action: As reported by Cryptopolitan, Cryptio's guidance is to remove all shared API keys through the exchange or custodian, check accounts for fraudulent transactions or permission changes, and not link accounts until more is known.

validation.note: Only Cryptopolitan was read; it relays Cryptio's 22 November alert and a company representative's 26 November statement. The LinkedIn alert and a crypto.news report were not read.
